declarations.description:
A measurement inside a known range — storage used, a plan's quota, a password's strength — drawn as a bar with
its label and value above it. Unlike `c2-progress` it is not a task moving towards done: it has `min` and `max`, and
the native `<meter>` thresholds `low`, `high` and `optimum` judge the value as optimum, sub-optimum or critical,
which colours the bar (and is exposed as the `:state(optimum)`, `:state(suboptimum)` and `:state(critical)` custom
states for styling around it). Give it `segments` instead of a `value` to split the bar into parts, such as
photos, documents and mail in a storage quota, with a legend underneath.

The value shows as a percentage of the range in the page's language; `value-text` replaces it with your own words
("12.4 GB of 15 GB"), which are also what a screen reader announces, and the `value` slot replaces only what is
shown. A segmented meter shows and announces its total against `max`, and reads each segment out by name.

slots.description: Label shown above the bar; also the meter's accessible name. Falls back to the `label` attribute.
Replaces the value shown beside the label. Announced text still comes from `value-text`.
slots.name: value

members.name: value
members.description: The measurement, between `min` and `max`. Ignored when `segments` are set.

members.name: low
members.description: Upper end of the low region, as in the native `<meter>`.

members.name: high
members.description: Lower end of the high region, as in the native `<meter>`.

members.name: optimum
members.description:
The best value. Below `low` it makes low values optimum and high ones critical (a fuel gauge reads the other
way: `optimum` above `high`); between them the middle region is optimum and both ends sub-optimum.

members.name: segments
members.description: Parts of a segmented meter, `{ label, value, color? }`, in range units. Accepts a JSON string as an attribute.

members.name: label
members.description: Label when the default slot is empty.

members.name: valueText
members.description: Words for the value ("12.4 GB of 15 GB"), shown and announced in place of the percentage or the total.

members.name: range
members.description: Lower and upper end of the range, with a `max` below `min` treated as equal to it.

members.name: current
members.description: The value the bar and the tone use: `value`, or the segments' sum, clamped to the range.

members.name: tone
members.description: How good the current value is, judged from `low`, `high` and `optimum` the way the native `<meter>` does.

members.name: shownValue
members.description:
The value as shown: `value-text`, the segments' sum against the size of the range (both counted from `min`, like
the legend), or the percentage of the range.

members.name: announcedValue
members.description: What a screen reader hears: the shown value, after each segment by name in a segmented meter.
